plan: track 2 of the historical-evidence remediation plan (~/Desktop/traceability-historical-evidence-plan.md)
scope: Independent re-verification of already-recovered historical evidence for release-plan entries 001-077 (.agent/tasks/compliance-515/519-inventory-evidence.json). Not a fresh recovery pass: #519 already performed an exhaustive issue/PR/commit/CI/release recovery for all 82 entries (MC-13, Step 2 of 519-spec.md), independently reviewed and corrected once (519-ci-correction-evidence.json, finding 519-REPORT-CI-OMISSION).
methodology: Classified all 77 historical entries' recorded ci_evidence shape: 38 entries already use an aggregated per-commit summary that exhaustively lists non_success_checks by construction; 3 entries (002, 018, 039) were already hand-corrected to the same exhaustive hybrid shape by #519; 3 entries (010, 012, 019) have zero recorded commits because they are standalone planning/investigation stages whose issue was closed by a later sibling release-plan entry's implementation PR, not by a commit of their own.

Identified the remaining 33 entries as the genuine audit target: their recorded ci_evidence is a single representative check-run (e.g. 'CI Gate: success') with no field proving every check run on that commit was inspected for a non-success conclusion.

For each of the 33, queried `gh api repos/vixygrey/truenorth-mcp/commits/<sha>/check-runs --paginate` live against the real commit SHA already on file, and compared the full live check-run list's conclusions against the recorded single-check-run evidence.

For the 3 zero-commit entries, ran `gh pr list --search '<issue> in:body' --state all` as a supplementary check to confirm no overlooked PR exists; confirmed each issue's only merged PR is already attributed to its implementation sibling entry, not an orphaned PR for the planning-stage entry itself.
